packet.title: FLWOR and other expressions (implementation) — Early
packet.summary: Adds the xquery lowering part for FLWOR clauses, quantified, typeswitch, switch, ordered, unordered and extension expressions, with validate raising XQST0075.

body.p: After . Owns src/xquery_lower.c, src/xquery_lower_internal.h, tests/xquery_lower_test.c. Lowering part: for (at, allowing empty, member, key/value), let, where, order by (stable, empty greatest/least, collation), count, while (4.0), trace clause, return; quantified expressions with types; typeswitch, switch (4.0 forms); ordered, unordered; extension expressions (unknown pragmas ignored); validate raises XQST0075 (). IR dumps of ten queries match golden text. Done when prod-FLWORExpr, prod-ForClause, prod-LetClause, prod-WhereClause, prod-OrderByClause, prod-CountClause, prod-WhileClause, prod-TypeswitchExpr, prod-SwitchExpr ≥ 90% (through 3.12, unit IR dumps before). Spec: XQuery 4.0 "FLWOR Expressions". Done 2026-10-17 (): part xquery in src/xquery_lower.c, internal entry sxml_xquery_compile; 12 IR dumps, static errors and allocation failures in tests/xquery_lower_test.c. Scratch harness (XQ40): For 139/212, Let 158/189, Where 68/85, OrderBy 133/210, Count 13/13, While 69/83, Typeswitch 80/88, Switch 34/58, TryCatch 190/212; every other run case needs a prolog (3.10) or group by (3.8) but 8.
